narrative.headline: Top 50 tilts decisively bullish (35 of 50 bullish/lean bullish) led by defensives, financials, and legacy tech — but smart money is distributing the AI/semiconductor complex.
bullish_setups: LLY: perfect 10.0 composite — max call premium + $291M dark pool + heavy blocks, pharma leadership
ABBV: 9.96 score with $264M dark pool conviction stacking on full-weight call flow
GOOG: $21M call premium + $1.06B dark pool — largest absolute institutional footprint on the board
JPM/BAC: financials accumulation — JPM 9.82, BAC 9.10, both with $230M+ dark pool prints
NFLX/META: mega-cap consumer tech bid — $15M and $40M call premium respectively, both with 10.0 darkpool/blocks
CAT: $12.5M call premium + $624M dark pool — industrial cycle bid
KO/WMT/COST: defensive consumer staples all scoring 8.8+ with massive dark pool accumulation
IBM/CSCO: legacy tech rotation — both 8.3+ with 10.0 darkpool and blocks
bearish_setups: NVDA: flow 4.07 — put premium dominant despite $10/10 dark pool and blocks (distribution into size)
PLTR: flow 3.97, full conviction amplifiers — institutions selling into strength
ORCL: flow 3.32, max dark pool/blocks — AI infrastructure name being unloaded
AMAT/KLAC: semicap equipment under pressure, KLAC at 0.94 is the weakest score on the board
AAPL: flow 2.85 with full $10 darkpool/blocks conviction — meaningful distribution
GE/HD/AXP: cyclical/consumer credit names showing bearish flow with heavy block conviction
MS: 2.47, the lone bearish financial against an otherwise bullish bank tape
narrative.rotation_signal: Clear rotation OUT of AI/semis (NVDA, PLTR, ORCL, AMAT, KLAC, AAPL) and INTO defensives (LLY, ABBV, KO, WMT, COST), financials ex-MS (JPM, BAC), and legacy tech (IBM, CSCO, GOOG). Dark pool conviction on the bearish names is maximal, suggesting this is deliberate institutional distribution into retail strength, not passive de-risking.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: NVDA and ORCL bearish reads likely diverge from broader semis/software industry bullishness — Top 50 smart money is fading the AI trade at the single-name level even where sector flow may still look constructive. AAPL bearish read also notable against typical mega-cap tech tape.
